descriptionChirho: To add something, increase quantity or degree; Arabic زاد/يزيد (zada) or أضاف/يُضيف (aḍafa) indicating quantitative augmentation in the Hifil causative stem.
To continue doing, resume, do again as auxiliary verb; Arabic عاد/يعود (ʿada/yaʿudu) indicating repetition or continuation of an action in the Hifil stem.

Waw-consecutive Hifil imperfect narrating sequential addition or continuation; covers both Arabic وعاد (wa-ʿada, 'and resumed') and وأضاف/وزاد (wa-aḍafa/wa-zada, 'and added') in narrative past contexts.
Qal stem expressing simple continuation or repetition of an action; Arabic عاد (ʿada, 'returned/resumed') indicating doing something again without causative force.

labelChirho: shall add, shall continue (Qal conjunctive perfect)
descriptionChirho: Qal weqatal (conjunctive perfect) forms expressing future addition, increase, or continuation; covers both adding quantity (Arabic يُضيف/يزيد) and resuming action (Arabic يعود).
Nifal passive or reflexive: to be added, be increased, or join oneself to; Arabic يُزاد (yuzadu, passive 'be increased'), أُضيف (uḍifa, 'was added'), or انضمّ (inḍamma, 'joined oneself').
Perfect tense active forms denoting completed acts of increasing or adding quantity; Arabic زاد (zada) or أضاف (aḍafa) in completed aspect, distinct from the continuation/resumption sense.
